# LLM Integration Gotchas

> Known gotchas when integrating LLM / reasoning-model APIs (streaming chat completions, tool calling, SSE parsing). Provider-general; examples use OpenRouter's OpenAI-compatible HTTP. Load all HIGH entries before writing agent-loop or LLM-streaming code.

## Entries

- [Reasoning models spiral silently in delta.reasoning](reasoning-model-spiral.md): Reasoning models stream chain-of-thought in `delta.reasoning` / `delta.reasoning_content`, separate from `delta.content` and `delta.tool_calls`. A spiral floods reasoning while emitting zero content and zero tool calls, so the turn looks like a silent empty hang until timeout. Count reasoning deltas and warn on the signature. HIGH.
- [Confirmed tool actions need a durable continuation turn](confirmed-tool-actions-need-durable-continuation.md): Persisting a confirmed tool result without queuing a new model turn leaves the chat silently stopped at "action completed" even though the action succeeded. Store the result and idempotent continuation together, then follow that continuation stream. HIGH.
- [A tool-argument type error can be the client, not the parameter](tool-arg-type-errors.md): `data/requested must be boolean` usually means the schema omitted a bound the server enforces, or the client serialized every argument as text -- not that the parameter is wrong. One working client is not evidence the schema is fine. Publish every bound and enum, accept both boolean spellings as an enum, and narrow once at the dispatcher keyed on the schema. HIGH.
